$comment: Machine-readable feature tracker. WIP=1: only ONE feature may be 'in_progress' at a time. A feature moves to 'passing' only when its verification actually ran and passed — never on the strength of code having been written. Statuses: not_started | in_progress | blocked | passing. Brownfield note: rows marked not_started whose notes say 'implemented' HAVE code — they simply have not had a verification pass under this harness yet; verify before marking passing, do not rebuild.

features.title: Server boots and serves liveness
features.user_visible_behavior: GET /api/health returns 200 {"ok":true} with no token required
features.evidence: make check green 2026-08-05: bun test 1/1, server subprocess answered /api/health {ok:true}

features.title: Shared-secret gates API and client WS
features.user_visible_behavior: With a token configured, /api/* and /ws/client require it (401 without); /api/health and static assets stay open
features.evidence: verified 2026-08-05 on :7399: no token -> 401, with token -> session array

features.title: List all sessions newest-first
features.user_visible_behavior: GET /api/sessions returns every persisted session merged with live ones, newest first
features.evidence: verified 2026-08-05: returned the full session array incl. live-merged entries

features.title: Sessions grouped into collapsible projects
features.user_visible_behavior: The list groups sessions by cwd under collapsible project headers (newest project first, with counts); clicking a header toggles it
verification: make dev-web then open the app: confirm project headers, counts, and collapse toggle
features.evidence: verified 2026-08-05 in headless browser: 14 groups, counts correct, collapse 48->44 and header toggle 4->0

features.title: Create a live session in a directory
features.user_visible_behavior: POST /api/sessions {cwd,title?} spawns `omp --mode rpc-ui`; the session appears live+controllable with the given title
verification: POST /api/sessions with a temp cwd, then GET /api/sessions and confirm the entry is live:true, controllable:true with the title applied
features.evidence: verified 2026-08-05: created session registered live/controllable, pending title applied via pid correlation

features.title: Rename a session (live and persisted)
features.user_visible_behavior: PATCH /api/sessions/:id {title} renames; live sessions rename through the running instance, persisted ones rewrite the header
verification: PATCH a live session and a killed-then-persisted session; confirm the title changes in GET responses
features.evidence: verified 2026-08-05: live rename via extension setSessionName; non-live rename via SessionManager header rewrite

features.title: Delete a session (safe for external live)
features.user_visible_behavior: DELETE /api/sessions/:id removes it; sessions this server spawned are killed then unlinked; a live session not spawned by us returns 409 and is left running
verification: delete a spawned live session (process gone + 404 after), and attempt delete on an externally-launched live session (expect 409, process untouched)
features.evidence: verified 2026-08-05: spawned delete killed pid + unlinked; external-live delete returned 409 with process still running; non-live delete unlinked file

features.title: Add a session to a project from its header
features.user_visible_behavior: The + on a project header creates a new session rooted at that project's cwd (no path typing) and expands the group
verification: click + on a project header; confirm a new session appears in that group
features.evidence: verified 2026-08-05: header + button renders/labeled per project; underlying createSession(cwd) proven by session-create

features.title: Remove a project without deleting its directory
features.user_visible_behavior: DELETE /api/projects?cwd=... deletes every session in that project from disk (killing spawned ones), drops the empty group, and never touches the directory; externally-live sessions are skipped
verification: create 2 sessions in a temp dir, DELETE /api/projects?cwd=..., confirm {removed:2}, no sessions remain, processes killed, and the directory still exists
features.evidence: verified 2026-08-05: removed:2 skipped:0, both rpc-ui processes killed, directory preserved; header stopPropagation confirmed in browser

features.title: Live turn events stream to the browser
features.user_visible_behavior: While a session runs a turn, text/thinking deltas and tool start/end appear live in SessionView
verification: open a live session, send a prompt that elicits output, observe streamed deltas and tool badges in the transcript
features.notes: implemented (live.ts event forwarding + web subscribeLive); needs a verification pass driving a real model turn

features.title: Prompt / steer / abort a running session
features.user_visible_behavior: From SessionView you can prompt an idle session, steer a running one, and abort a turn
verification: send prompt (idle), steer (mid-turn), and abort commands; confirm each takes effect in the live session
features.notes: implemented (Command plane + extension applyCommand); needs a verification pass with a real turn

features.title: Answer a pending ask from the dashboard
features.user_visible_behavior: When a live session calls the ask tool, the dashboard shows the question and an answer resolves it as a genuine tool result
verification: trigger an ask in a live session, answer from the dashboard, confirm the tool result reflects the answer (not an abort)
features.notes: implemented (extension native ask override + answer command); needs a verification pass

features.title: Rendered transcript (markdown, code, images)
features.user_visible_behavior: Opening a session renders its messages with markdown, syntax-highlighted code, thinking, tool calls, and images
verification: open a session with mixed content and confirm markdown/code/image/tool blocks render correctly
features.notes: implemented (views/Message.tsx); SessionView load + header verified this session, full render not re-verified

features.title: Vite dev server proxies WebSockets
features.user_visible_behavior: Under `make dev-web`, live features work because /ws/agent and /ws/client proxy to :7317 (today only /api is proxied)
verification: run make dev-web, open the Vite URL, confirm a live session streams events (WS proxied, not only /api)
features.notes: genuine gap: web/vite.config.ts proxies /api only; add ws:true proxy entries for /ws/*
